units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:5">T’bul Yom I, 5</cite> ed. Dehr. (ed. <cite ref="U01546"><he>שֻׁמְשׁוּם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 13a:5">R. Hash. 13ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 103b:17">Men. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>כביצה חסר ש׳</he> the size of an egg less that of a sesame seed.

<cite ref="Menachot 16b:23">Ib. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>הקטיר ש׳ לאכול ש׳</he> if he burnt (the handful of the offering), the size of a sesame grain at a time, or with the intention to eat (the remainder), a sesame grain at a time; a. e.—Mostly pl. <cite ref="U00462"><he>שׁוּמְשְׁמִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00462"><he>שׁוּמְשְׁמִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:4">Ḥall. I, 4</cite>. Mekh. Bo, s. 8.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:2">Sabb. II, 2</cite> <he>שמן ש׳</he> sesame oil (used in lamps).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2:3">Tosef. ib. II, 3</cite> <he>מה יעשו … שמן ש׳</he> what shall the Babylonians do who have nothing but sesame oil? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:1:6">Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ</cite> top <he>אפי׳ ש׳</he> even as much (of the incense) as the size of a sesame seed.
